narrative:
The integrated P&L consolidates every upstream step into one plan: EUR 15.6B net sales and EUR 905M EBIT (5.8% margin), up from EUR 640M in FY2025.

Price & mix (+EUR 170M) and volume (+EUR 95M) are the main growth drivers; the plant footprint programme adds EUR 85M once Rzeszów reaches run-rate. Material cost (-EUR 60M) and restructuring/FX (-EUR 70M) are the main headwinds.

Every number traces back to ACDOCA actuals and the approved driver assumptions — one version of the truth from S/4HANA through Snowflake to SAC, ready for Management Board sign-off.

signals.title: F&C Workshop Munich — UDP Evaluation
signals.excerpt: ~30 F&C stakeholders reviewed ACDOCA access, real-time P&L, Material Ledger and Cortex Analyst. Priority: replace BW E0P, keep SAC as planning frontend, single source for actuals.

signals.title: Manufacturing Footprint Programme
signals.excerpt: Two German sites closing; volume transferring to the new Rzeszów factory. Under-absorption during ramp-up is the largest cost risk in FY2026.

signals.title: Material Ledger Actual Cost Close
signals.excerpt: Actual cost variances on steel, resins and electronics now visible per material and plant in near-real time — replacing month-end BW extracts.
